description: This PHP source file contains a test class named PayGradeDaoTest which is used to perform unit testing on the PayGradeDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It includes set up procedures, various test methods to verify DAO functionalities such as retrieving, saving, and deleting pay grade and currency data, and uses PHPUnit assertions. The class is distinguished by its specific focus on PayGrade and related entities, making it unique to the admin DAO testing context.

classes.name: PayGradeDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the PayGradeDao, testing data retrieval, creation, and deletion methods for pay grades and related entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of PayGradeDao, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of pay grades, asserting count and specific entries.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Verifies fetching of a pay grade by ID and checks the name field.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of currency list associated with a specific pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific currency by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriods
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of available pay periods.

methods.name: testGetCurrencies
methods.description: Tests getting list of all currencies.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyById
methods.description: Checks fetching of currency details by currency ID.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of pay grade currencies based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a list of pay grade currency entities for a given pay grade.

methods.name: testGetPayGradesCount
methods.description: Verifies total count of pay grades based on search filters.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new pay grade entity.

methods.name: testSavePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Tests saving a new pay grade currency association.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: testDeletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Tests deletion of pay grade currencies for a specific pay grade ID.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed pay currencies for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Checks count of allowed pay currencies for a specific pay grade.
